heading: Friday, September 5, 2025
topLine: 2 model releases: Alibaba Qwen3-Max-Preview and Moonshot AI Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905.

items.headline: Alibaba releases Qwen3-Max-Preview, its first trillion-parameter model
items.summary: Qwen3-Max-Preview (Instruct) is a closed-weight model with over one trillion parameters, offered through Qwen Chat and the Alibaba Cloud API. Alibaba says it beats its previous top model, Qwen3-235B-A22B-2507, in internal benchmarks.

image.alt: Qwen3-Max-Preview benchmark scores compared with other models

items.headline: Moonshot AI updates Kimi K2 with 256K context
items.summary: Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905 is an updated K2 checkpoint that extends the context window from 128K to 256K tokens and improves agentic and front-end coding. Moonshot reports SWE-bench Verified rising to 69.2 from 65.8; weights are released under a modified MIT license.
